title: Can't include the necessary thermometer?
text: Can't include the necessary thermometer?. I would have given this a 5 star rating, however I  very disappointed that this doesn't come with the thermometer that is absolutely necessary to make yogurt. I've owned vintage older yogurt models from the 70's and 80's and back in the day, as a courtesy to the consumer a thermometer was included. Mind you it's a cheap add on and I can run out to my local Target or Walmart store to buy one for around $4.00 - but the inconvenience of having to go buy one annoys me. Why not raise the price of the product a couple bucks and add one? You can't make yogurt without it.
